_about: THE glucose units (#24): values are stored, sent, alerted on and exported in mg/dL; mmol/L is only how they are shown
and typed (setting general.unit). One conversion and formatting function per platform: Android :core:model
GlucoseUnit.kt, Mac SukraraCore GlucoseUnit.swift; both are tested against this file (Android UnitsFixtureTest in
:core:graph, Mac GlucoseUnitTests). Every surface writes a glucose number through them: the card's value, the chart's
range labels and lines, the spoken sentence, notifications, alert copy, widgets, status bar, Mac menu bar, settings.
factor   mg/dL per mmol/L: 18.0182 (glucose's molar mass 180.16 g/mol / 10, the WHO / IFCC factor; xDrip+'s
MMOLL_TO_MGDL and the CSV export's). Others in use: AndroidAPS and many dosing charts 18, Nightscout
18.01559; Abbott (LibreLink) and Dexcom don't publish theirs and show one decimal. 18 and 18.0182 differ in
the shown decimal at 46 of the 361 values 40-400 (e.g. 100 mg/dL: 5.5 here, 5.6 at 18), never by more than 0.1.
round    half away from zero on the exact quotient: value = sign * floor(|mgdl / factor| * 10^d + 0.5) / 10^d.
value    a glucose value: mg/dL whole numbers; mmol/L one decimal, always written ('5.0', never '5').
rate     a trend rate (mg/dL/min): mg/dL/min one decimal; mmol/L/min two decimals (0.1 mg/dL/min = 0.0055).
decimal  the separator of the language: '.' in English, ',' in Spanish ('7,8'). Data formats (CSV export, wire,
broadcasts) never use the shown unit or the comma: they stay mg/dL.
bounds   LO / HI are words in both units (Freshness.valueText); what they mean is written with the bound in the unit:
'below 40 mg/dL' / 'below 2.2 mmol/L', 'above 400 mg/dL' / 'above 22.2 mmol/L'.
input    a value typed or picked in mmol/L becomes the stored mg/dL on the schema format's step (whole mg/dL; 0.1
mg/dL/min for rates): stored = round(shown * factor / step) * step, then the format's coerce. A number
setting in mg/dL has a 'mmol' variant in settings.json (its own min, max, step, nudge, decimals and presets
in mmol/L); every value of that variant's grid must come back unchanged (stored, then shown again), which
every platform's test checks for every variant.
